title: HII Celebrates National Recognition for Infrastructure Excellence at Savannah River Site
summary: HII is America's largest military shipbuilding company, delivering advanced warships, submarines, and mission technology solutions in service of the nation.
body_markdown:
HII proudly celebrates the recognition of four Savannah River Site (SRS) teams for infrastructure excellence by the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), highlighting the dedication, technical expertise and commitment to mission success demonstrated across the site.


Through its joint venture involvement in Savannah River Nuclear Solutions in South Carolina, HII brings more than six decades of[nuclear expertise and operational discipline](https://www.hii.com/capabilities/nuclear-environmental) to some of the nation’s most complex environmental management and national security missions.


This recognition underscores the importance of maintaining safe, reliable infrastructure and the exceptional teamwork required to support the nation’s nuclear enterprise.


HII congratulates the award-winning teams and their partners at Savannah River Nuclear Solutions (SRNS) for their outstanding contributions to this critical mission.


Read the full SRNS news release:[Four SRS Teams Recognized by NNSA for Infrastructure Excellence⁠](https://public.srs.gov/2026/09/four-srs-teams-recognized-by-nnsa-for-infrastructure-excellence/)


S *avannah River Nuclear Solutions, an HII and Fluor partnership company, is responsible for the management and operations of the Department of Energy’s Savannah River Site, located near Aiken, South Carolina.*
